statement: The rational conics specified in equation (1), consisting of the hyperbola 20x^2-5y^2+1=0 and two perturbed double lines, have 144 real tritangent circles. Numerical certification establishes the example and disproves the earlier conjectured maximum 136. This proves a lower bound 144 on the maximum, not its equality to 144.

source.location: Theorem 1.1; explicit triple (1); numerical-certification Appendix (attainability consequence)

scope: Three general complex plane conics; circles are conics through the two circular points at infinity.
notes: An individual attainable count; this does not settle the complete spectrum.
